ad_intelligence.desc: Analyzing ads or marketing creatives at scale (hooks, offers, CTAs, competitor ads)
ad_intelligence.idea_en: SaaS that scans competitors' live ads weekly and emails a report of the hooks that work.
ad_intelligence.idea_fr: SaaS qui scanne chaque semaine les pubs actives des concurrents et envoie un rapport des accroches qui marchent.

content_virality.desc: Scoring or improving social media posts, predicting virality, content optimization for creators
content_virality.idea_en: Extension or app that scores a post before publishing and suggests edits; monthly creator subscription.
content_virality.idea_fr: Extension ou app qui note un post avant publication et suggère quoi changer ; abonnement mensuel créateurs.

newsjacking_pr.desc: Monitoring news or trends and matching them to brands, PR, press opportunities
newsjacking_pr.idea_en: Daily 'which stories to jump on today' alert for brands and PR agencies.
newsjacking_pr.idea_fr: Alerte quotidienne « quelles actus reprendre aujourd'hui » pour marques et agences PR.

lead_scoring.desc: Scoring sales leads, matching prospects to messages, outreach personalization, buying signals
lead_scoring.idea_en: CRM plugin that scores every lead and outreach message before sending.
lead_scoring.idea_fr: Plugin CRM qui note chaque lead et chaque message de prospection avant envoi.

email_triage.desc: Classifying, prioritizing or routing emails, inbox triage
email_triage.idea_en: Inbox assistant that sorts and prioritizes in real time for a few dollars a month.
email_triage.idea_fr: Assistant de boîte mail qui trie et priorise en temps réel pour quelques euros par mois.

support_routing.desc: Routing or classifying customer support tickets, chat intents, helpdesk automation
support_routing.idea_en: Zendesk / Intercom app that classifies and routes every ticket instantly.
support_routing.idea_fr: App Zendesk / Intercom qui classe et route chaque ticket instantanément.

code_review.desc: Reviewing pull requests or code diffs, detecting risky changes, code quality checks
code_review.idea_en: GitHub App running typed checks on every PR (secrets, auth, deleted tests), billed per repo.
code_review.idea_fr: GitHub App qui pose 15 contrôles typés sur chaque PR (secrets, auth, tests supprimés), facturée par dépôt.

agent_safety.desc: Guarding AI agents: approving shell commands, permissions, tool-call safety, guardrails
agent_safety.idea_en: Natural-language permission layer for coding agents, sold to teams.
agent_safety.idea_fr: Couche de permissions en langage naturel pour agents de code, vendue aux équipes.

context_compaction.desc: Compacting or pruning an AI agent's context, memory selection, deciding what to keep in context
context_compaction.idea_en: Claude Code / Codex plugin that prunes context in 1s; license or freemium.
context_compaction.idea_fr: Plugin pour Claude Code / Codex qui élague le contexte en 1 s ; licence ou freemium.

browser_automation.desc: Browser agents or computer use: choosing clicks, typing and navigation on web pages or desktop apps
browser_automation.idea_en: Ultra-fast web automation API billed per use (scraping, forms, bookings).
browser_automation.idea_fr: API d'automatisation web ultra-rapide facturée à l'usage (scraping, formulaires, réservations).

qa_testing.desc: Automated QA testing of apps, adversarial testing, test agents
qa_testing.idea_en: Service that runs automatic testers on every deploy and flags regressions.
qa_testing.idea_fr: Service qui lance des testeurs automatiques sur chaque déploiement et signale les régressions.

tool_routing.desc: Routing requests between tools, models or skills; choosing which LLM or handler to use
tool_routing.idea_en: Router sending each request to the cheapest capable model; take a cut of the savings.
tool_routing.idea_fr: Routeur qui envoie chaque requête au modèle le moins cher capable de la traiter ; commission sur l'économie réalisée.

search_ranking.desc: Search, reranking results, RAG passage selection, launchers ranking by intent
search_ranking.idea_en: Plug-and-play reranker for e-commerce or docs site search.
search_ranking.idea_fr: Reranker plug-and-play pour la recherche interne d'un site e-commerce ou d'une doc.

data_labeling.desc: Classifying rows of data, spreadsheets, databases, CSV labeling, research paper or document sorting
data_labeling.idea_en: Google Sheets / Excel add-on: a column that classifies or scores every row in plain language.
data_labeling.idea_fr: Add-on Google Sheets / Excel : une colonne qui classe ou note chaque ligne en langage naturel.

moderation.desc: Content moderation, spam, rage bait, scam detection, feed filtering
moderation.idea_en: Extension hiding rage bait, spam and crypto from your feed; small subscription.
moderation.idea_fr: Extension qui masque rage bait, spam et crypto dans ton fil ; petit abonnement.

trading_signals.desc: Trading decisions, market signals, buy/sell bots, finance
trading_signals.idea_en: Fast decision bots; high risk and heavy regulation.
trading_signals.idea_fr: Bots de décision rapides ; risque élevé et régulation lourde.

game_bots.desc: Game-playing bots and game AI (Mario, chess, Minecraft, Doom, NPCs)
game_bots.idea_en: Reactive NPC SDK for indie devs, per-game license.
game_bots.idea_fr: SDK de PNJ réactifs pour développeurs indés, licence par jeu.

voice_control.desc: Voice commands mapped to actions, voice interfaces
voice_control.idea_en: Instant voice control for apps and browser, as a subscription.
voice_control.idea_fr: Contrôle vocal instantané d'apps et de navigateur, en abonnement.

adaptive_ui.desc: Adaptive or personalized interfaces, recommendations, predictive UX
adaptive_ui.idea_en: Widget that reorders a landing page per visitor; priced by traffic.
adaptive_ui.idea_fr: Widget qui réorganise une landing page selon le visiteur ; prix par volume de trafic.

robotics_iot.desc: Drones, robots, IoT, physical devices controlled by decisions
robotics_iot.idea_en: Decision layer for hobby robots; market still nascent.
robotics_iot.idea_fr: Couche de décision pour robots amateurs ; marché encore naissant.

dev_integration.desc: SDKs, libraries, wrappers or plugins that make Jev easier to use for developers (DuckDB, RubyLLM, MCP, languages)
dev_integration.idea_en: Ready-made System One connectors (Zapier, n8n, Make) sold on marketplaces.
dev_integration.idea_fr: Connecteurs System One prêts à l'emploi (Zapier, n8n, Make) vendus en marketplace.

education_content.desc: Teaching Jev: courses, tutorials, explainers, newsletters about building with Jev
education_content.idea_en: Mini-course or paid newsletter 'building with System One', with templates.
education_content.idea_fr: Mini-cours ou newsletter payante « construire avec System One », avec des templates.
